name: CUREv1_en_mteb
description: CUREv1_en_mteb is an English-language dataset in the MTEB-style embedding benchmark suite intended to evaluate embedding models across typical embedding tasks. It measures embedding quality for tasks such as semantic similarity, retrieval, and downstream classification/clustering by using task-specific ranking and classification metrics. The suite is intended for assessing general-purpose sentence and text embeddings.
evaluation_method: Task-specific embedding metrics such as recall@k, nDCG, MAP and classification metrics (accuracy/F1) depending on the task
general_score_metric: Task-dependent (commonly nDCG or recall@k; sometimes averaged across tasks)
reputation: Part of the MTEB/embedding-benchmark collection and used by the embeddings community as one of many standardized datasets for comparing vector representations.
